title: OOA Flow v1
description: Versioned definition of a ONEOFFICEAUTOMATION automation. Shared by Studio, Recorder, Runner, the AI co-pilot, the agent runtime, Git sync and import/export. Changes within v1 are additive only.

kind.description: Automation kind. TaskBot = desktop/UI bot; ApiTask = headless bot for containers; Process = long-running; Form = Assist form; Agent = AI agent definition.

id.description: Stable automation identifier, unique per tenant.

name.description: Human-readable name shown in Control Center and used as the MCP tool title.

description.description: What the automation does. Required for publishing as an agent tool, because the model reads it to decide when to call the tool.

version.description: Repository version number; assigned on check-in.

requires.description: Execution prerequisites resolved before a run is dispatched.

files.description: Files of the Command Center repository the agent uses (for example Templates/invoice.xlsx); they are placed at the same path in the runner's workspace before the run.

capabilities.description: Device capabilities needed. ApiTask flows must not require 'desktop'.

variables.description: Typed variables. Input variables become the tool input schema when the automation is exposed to agents or MCP clients; output variables become the tool result.

errorHandling.description: Default error policy for the whole automation.

default.description: What to do when a step fails outside any Try block.

ui.description: Studio layout (canvas positions keyed by step id). Kept apart from logic so diffs and AI generation stay clean. Ignored by the Runner.

name.description: Variable name, referenced in expressions as $name.

direction.description: input = supplied by caller; output = returned to caller; in_out = both; local = internal.

required.description: For inputs: the run is rejected when the value is missing and no default exists.

default.description: Initial value. Not allowed for Credential variables.

description.description: Shown in Studio and given to agents as the tool parameter description.

max.description: Maximum retry attempts after the first failure.

codes.description: Only retry these error codes. Default: errors marked retryable.

id.description: Stable step id used for breakpoints, logs, diffs and checkpoints. Unique within the flow.

action.description: Command address package/action, e.g. ooa.excel/get_cell or core/if.

args.description: Action inputs, validated against the package manifest. Values may be literals, $references, '${expr}' interpolations or {"expr": "..."} objects.

out.description: Map of action output name to variable name.

catch.description: Catch blocks of core/try, matched in order by error code.

codes.description: Error codes or prefixes ending in '*'. Empty = catch all.

message_to.description: Variable that receives the error message (String).

line_to.description: Variable that receives the line number of the step that failed (Number), as numbered in Agent Studio's list.

as.description: Variable that receives the error as a Dictionary (code, message, suggestedFix, stepId, line, action and, with screenshot, the picture's path).

screenshot.description: Take a screenshot when this block catches an error: true saves it under screenshots/ in the workspace, a text value is the file path to use. Never fails the Catch.

continueOnError.description: Errors raised by steps inside this Catch block are logged and skipped.

rethrow.description: After running this Catch block, raise the original error again so an outer Try or the run sees it.

connection.description: Name of a saved connection (Command Center or connections.json) that supplies this step's address and sign-in inputs.

agent.description: AI agent definition (kind = Agent). Agents run through the AI Gateway and call published automations as tools.

goalTemplate.description: Optional template turning input variables into the user goal, e.g. 'Handle this email: ${email}'.

modelConnection.description: Name of a model connection configured by an AI admin.

automation.description: Id of a published automation exposed as a tool.

sensitive.description: Sensitive tools need human approval before every call.

description.description: Overrides the automation description given to the model.

maxSteps.description: Maximum model turns before the run stops with status limit_reached.

maxCostUsd.description: Cost ceiling for one agent run.

outputSchema.description: Optional JSON Schema the final answer must satisfy.
